sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Thêm một đêm là bao nhiêu? is the quick money check before you agree to a ride, ticket, item, or service. It keeps the exchange focused on one extra night, so the answer can be a number, calculator screen, or typed price.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Ask Thêm một đêm là bao nhiêu? before you hand over money. Keep the item, ticket, ride screen, or calculator visible so the price can be shown instead of explained quickly.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Numbers are easier to trust when they are visible. Ask the short phrase first, then invite a typed number, calculator screen, ticket, or written time if the answer comes too fast.
